_about: Labelled cases for the prompt-injection screen (src/injection.py). Each `text` is a user message as it would reach the gateway, usually a request plus a document that contains (or doesn't) text aimed at an AI. Injections come from nonprofit-agent's injection tests (P3), grant-review-workflow's red team and gold set (P5), and new ones written for a general gateway (new). Clean cases include deliberately hard ones: talk about prompt injection, ordinary instructions, the words 'ignore', 'system', 'override', 'verified'. Everything is synthetic, written by Claude in a Claude Code session for this project; names, organizations and domains are made up (.example). `split`: dev cases are for building and tuning the screen; held_out cases are scored once, at the end.
